lines.5: 「Whoa! What happened to you? Your face looks WAY too funny!」
lines.7: 「Sorry. If I look in a mirror right now, I might lose my nerve.」
lines.10: I took her by the shoulders.
lines.15: I had gotten an immediate yes.
lines.16: 「...Judging by your face, this isn't some punishment where they're forcing you to say it, is it?」
lines.18: 「To be completely honest, I love you.」
lines.19: I said it with utter seriousness.
lines.22: 「So you finally went weak in the knees for my charms.」
lines.25: 「You should be. You had me worried sick.」
lines.32: 「...Forget it. If that's how it is, then I'll...」
lines.34: 「I'll bring the two of you together myself.」
lines.35: 「Truth is, I've been interested in you as a girl too.」
lines.40: 「To think I even captured Subaru... My charms are seriously not to be underestimated.」
lines.41: 「Yeah. That carefree confidence is part of what I like.」
lines.42: 「I'm glad you feel that way, but I love Leo.」
lines.44: 「And when Leo learned how I felt about you, that's when he started acting cold.」
lines.45: 「Huh? Whether he steps aside or not, I'M the one who decides.」
lines.46: 「That's just the kind of guy Leo is.」
lines.47: 「Oh... So that's why he's been moping around.」
lines.51: 「Guess I've got no choice. I'll come too.」
lines.54: 「There's something we need to settle as men.」
lines.62: 「Wait. You mean your man-to-man talk was a passionate fistfight over the delicate flower that is me?」
lines.63: 「I don't think that was exactly it.」
lines.64: 「Even if it wasn't, this is where you're supposed to say yes!」
lines.65: 「Damn Subaru. He might be an idiot, but he still tricked me.」
lines.66: I was ashamed I'd doubted him for even a moment.
lines.67: In the end, he was the one who had volunteered to play the villain.
lines.72: 「Nah. I don't like the name Kinu, but coming from you right now, it doesn't sound bad.」
lines.73: 「Then I'll call you by your name from now on.」
